summary.text: Michael Thornton is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 37, in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the September 8 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Thornton ran for the New Hampshire House as a Republican in earlier cycles as well: in 2020 he advanced from the Republican primary in Hillsborough 23 and in 2022 from the primary in Hillsborough 43, and he was not among the four winners of either general election.
